mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which increases the likelihood of future monetary policy easing and reduces inflationary pressure, thereby supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a policy response from the Federal Reserve to prevent economic contraction, leading to positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 1400.0 and RSAFS < 750000.0 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS fall below thresholds (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 102.0 for three consecutive months signals a contraction in real output, which increases the probability of monetary policy accommodation and reduces inflation expectations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive during INDPRO declines (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to generate positive returns in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 335.0 with a 12-month growth rate exceeding 3.0% triggers a market expectation of persistent inflation, leading to a forward-looking repricing of risk-free rates and equity discount rates, which depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds threshold (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal has Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) over two consecutive quarters indicates strong underlying demand momentum, which reinforces corporate earnings growth and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 2.0% YoY and HOUST > 1500.0 for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST exceed thresholds (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 158,000 in two consecutive months signals a labor market slowdown, which increases the probability of Fed rate cuts and reduces real interest rates, thereby boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS falls below threshold (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 102.0 combined with a rise in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signals a stagflationary risk, where supply-side constraints meet tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to earnings contraction and risk-off sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO and FEDFUNDS exceed thresholds (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
